evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Haiti (secondary)
evidence.inspected_fact: Lists named arrondissements and department relationships; these are coarser than communes and need district/local-purpose review.

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Honduras (secondary)
evidence.inspected_fact: Lists municipalities grouped by department and distinguishes elected municipal mayors from department governors; offshore Bay Islands remain Caribbean by geography.

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Jamaica (secondary)
evidence.inspected_fact: Lists14 parishes; parish territories are meaningful small local references, while municipal Kingston/StAndrew relationships require distinct settlement/admin interpretation.

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Nicaragua (secondary)
evidence.inspected_fact: Lists named municipalities with department/autonomous-region context; Corn Island is a separately represented Caribbean island, not mainland region assignment by owner.

evidence.title: US Census Bureau geographic levels
evidence.inspected_fact: The official page distinguishes counties and county equivalents, including Alaska boroughs/census areas, independent cities, Louisiana parishes and District of Columbia.
